facts.text: Serve the quesadillas when Gale talks her way onto the Stab 3 set at Sunrise Studios.
facts.why: Wikipedia says Gale travels to Hollywood and finds Dewey working as an adviser on the Stab 3 set. Talking her way on was not confirmed.
facts.fix: Serve the quesadillas when Gale finds Dewey advising on the Stab 3 set.

facts.why: The Stab 3 set is real, but the stage number was not confirmed in sources read.

vibe.verdict: Studio truck setting suits the film within a film, but the menu is plain and misses Randy's tape and the mansion.
missing: Randy's video message from beyond the grave
The voice changer that sounds like Maureen
Sidney working a crisis hotline under an alias
ideas: Swap 'California sushi rolls' for 'Randy's last tape sushi' to use the video message.
Swap 'Milton's party mushroom vol-au-vents' note for the birthday party at Milton's mansion where the killer is revealed.
Swap the 'Iced mocha' house line for a Jennifer Jolie green juice.
Change the plain price column to Stab 3 call sheet times in place of 'Small, Big, Sweet, Sips'.
